dependency: Open draft PR 203 at 85dd9d4b5190e1daeb64ff5c362ca0f208a65f4e plus current main; no ledger-semantic changes after the first snapshot experiment
question: Can two implementation-distinct snapshot builders derive the same canonical ledger projection, so a receiver that opens neither SQLite ledger can preserve commit-state reconciliation only on agreement?
objects: One trusted local single-slot ledger, exact expected request, complete candidate, two canonical snapshot files, two receiver-selected byte pins, one ledger-derived projection, and two builder-provenance records.
types_and_domain: Strict canonical JSON; exact-rational ancestor records; bounded integer allowance; SHA-256 byte pins; a projection containing all snapshot-body fields except builder_source_sha256; and exactly StoredCommitted, ProvenUncommittedLedger, or UnknownCommitState.
quantifiers: Four agreement cases over two finite decision families and six controls: projection disagreement, identical builder provenance, changed candidate, changed expected history, wrong right pin, and missing right snapshot.
candidate_grammar: Both builders receive exactly profile, expected_request and candidate. The pair receiver receives those fields plus left_snapshot_sha256 and right_snapshot_sha256. Candidate grammar remains adva.research.decision-ledger-contention.v0.
semantics: The inherited builder validates through the old engine. The new builder independently parses and checks SQLite schema, rows, canonical JSON, fingerprints, allowance and stored-result bindings without importing the inherited builder or ledger validator. The pair receiver opens neither ledger, validates both pinned snapshots, requires equal canonical ledger projections and unequal nonempty builder-source maps, then emits the ordinary three outcomes. Any disagreement or unavailable input returns UnknownCommitState and never grants retry.
acceptance: All ten pair outcomes; two substantive families; exact projection-byte agreement for four valid pairs; distinct builder provenance; exact result/allowance recovery; disagreement and copied-builder controls rejected; pair receiver has no sqlite3 import or ledger path; no parent arithmetic replay, debit or retry.
protected: The exact expected request, candidate, transition key, stored result, allowance, checker fingerprints and source-ledger digest
Builder-specific provenance must not be erased merely to obtain byte equality
The pair receiver must not import sqlite3, open a ledger, rerun parent arithmetic, debit allowance or authorize retry
The two byte pins are receiver-selected inputs; digest equality is not authentication
No native operation, free, Close, Seal, M6 or universality claim
exit: Stop after ten pair calls or first unexpected outcome/limit. Retain failure evidence. At most one implementation correction replay.
residuals: Both builders still share Python and SQLite
The independent builder reimplements a frozen schema rather than using a different language or storage engine
No signature, hostile replacement defense, power-loss model, external action or distributed exactly-once guarantee
Agreement can preserve a common implementation mistake and is not original arithmetic proof
origin: Original ChatGPT-authored code, prose and synthetic evidence under Unknown v0.3; no external content incorporated.
